originalTitle: American Airlines (AAL) Registers a Bigger Fall Than the Market: Important Facts to Note
summary: American Airlines (AAL) reached $13.43 at the closing of the latest trading day, reflecting a -1.54% change compared to its last close.
content:
American Airlines (AAL) closed at $13.43 in the latest trading session, marking a -1.54% move from the prior day. The stock's performance was behind the S&P 500's daily loss of 0.33%. Elsewhere, the Dow lost 0.7%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq lost 0.12%.

Coming into today, shares of the world's largest airline had lost 10.68% in the past month. In that same time, the Transportation sector lost 1.96%, while the S&P 500 gained 3.87%.

The investment community will be paying close attention to the earnings performance of American Airlines in its upcoming release. In that report, analysts expect American Airlines to post earnings of -$0.26 per share. This would mark a year-over-year decline of 52.94%. Meanwhile, our latest consensus estimate is calling for revenue of $16.12 billion, up 17.77% from the prior-year quarter.

AAL's full-year Zacks Consensus Estimates are calling for earnings of -$0.16 per share and revenue of $62.99 billion. These results would represent year-over-year changes of -144.44% and +15.3%, respectively.

Investors should also pay attention to any latest changes in analyst estimates for American Airlines. These recent revisions tend to reflect the evolving nature of short-term business trends. As a result, we can interpret positive estimate revisions as a good sign for the business outlook.

Research indicates that these estimate revisions are directly correlated with near-term share price momentum. We developed the Zacks Rank to capitalize on this phenomenon. Our system takes these estimate changes into account and delivers a clear, actionable rating model.

The Zacks Rank system, spanning from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), boasts an impressive track record of outperformance, audited externally, with #1 ranked stocks yielding an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the past month, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has shifted 977.7% downward. American Airlines is currently a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

The Transportation - Airline industry is part of the Transportation sector. With its current Zacks Industry Rank of 176, this industry ranks in the bottom 29% of all industries, numbering over 250.

The Zacks Industry Rank gauges the strength of our individual industry groups by measuring the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: 美国航空 (AAL) 的跌幅大于市场：需要注意的重要事实
chineseSummary: 美国航空(AAL)最新交易日收盘价达到13.43美元，较上一交易日收盘价上涨-1.54%。
chineseContent:
美国航空 (AAL) 在最新交易日收于 13.43 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -1.54%。该股的表现导致标准普尔 500 指数每日下跌 0.33%。其他方面，道指下跌 0.7%，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌 0.12%。

截至今天，这家全球最大航空公司的股价在过去一个月内下跌了 10.68%。与此同时，交通运输板块下跌 1.96%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨 3.87%。

投资界将密切关注美国航空即将发布的盈利表现。在那份报告中，分析师预计美国航空将公布每股收益 - 0.26 美元。这意味着同比下降 52.94%。与此同时，我们最新的共识预测收入为 161.2 亿美元，比去年同期增长 17.77%。

AAL 的全年 Zacks 共识预期为每股收益 - 0.16 美元，收入为 629.9 亿美元。这些结果将分别代表-144.44% 和+15.3% 的同比变化。

投资者还应关注分析师对美国航空的估计的最新变化。这些最近的修订往往反映了短期业务趋势不断变化的性质。因此，我们可以将积极的估计修正解读为业务前景的好兆头。

研究表明，这些估计修正与近期股价动能直接相关。我们开发了 Zacks Rank 来利用这一现象。我们的系统会考虑这些估计变化，并提供清晰、可操作的评级模型。

Zacks Rank 系统从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），拥有令人印象深刻的优异表现记录，经外部审计，排名第一的股票自 1988 年以来平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去的一个月里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计向下移动了 977.7%。美国航空目前在 Zacks 排名第三（持有）。

运输 - 航空业是运输部门的一部分。该行业目前的 Zacks 行业排名为 176，在所有行业中排名垫底 29%，数量超过 250 个。

Zacks 行业排名通过衡量各个行业组中个股的平均 Zacks 排名来衡量各个行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
